defects.problem: Outgoing end-card kicker 'Try ShowMe, and read the code.' overlaps the legal line 'Built solo...' as unreadable text for about 3 s, visible over two sample frames
defects.fix: Fade out the old caption fully before the new line appears, or stack them

defects.problem: White end-card panel jumps from the screen's frame shape to a larger shape while ShowMe wordmark fades over the still-visible billing screen
defects.fix: Use a clean crossfade into the held end card, no ghosted overlap

defects.problem: End card holds about eight seconds with the right half and bottom empty, content left-aligned

oneLineVerdict: Opening three beats are clean, but the end card transition has visible text collision.
